//: Single source of truth for response headers. Served by `vite preview` (so every e2e run exercises the production CSP) and by the CloudFront response headers policy in infra/. HSTS is added by CloudFront only.
Content-Security-Policy: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self'; style-src 'self'; img-src 'self' data:; media-src 'self' blob:; connect-src 'self'; font-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'
